name: jev-codex-router
description: Install and operate Codex Auto Router (Early Access), with configurable role models and adaptive effort.

interface.shortDescription: Set up configurable Codex roles and adaptive effort.
interface.longDescription: Guides installation of the local Codex Auto Router distribution with TypeSafe/Jev or OpenCode Go classification. Installing this plugin does not start local services or configure credentials.
defaultPrompt: Help me install Codex Auto Router without exposing my credentials.
Diagnose why Auto (Role Router) is not routing a request.
